name: client-preview-gate
title: Client preview gate
description: Your next chapter is ready for a first look. Enter the code from your invitation. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: all blocks share controlled input and visibility props. The consumer owns unlocked.

meta.whenToUse: The full client-facing ceremony: your logo, the recipient's name, remaining lifetime, code entry, a route back to you, and chrome around the work after unlock.
meta.notFor: Internal or staging previews, where the branding is noise. Use Quick gate.
pitfalls: `unlocked` is the only visibility decision in this library. `status="success"` styles the form and unlocks nothing.
`onSubmit` reports the attempt. Verify the code on your server and set `unlocked` from that result.
Locked children are never rendered, so protected markup is absent before unlock — but the data that produced it still needs authorization behind its own request.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled code value; required. No code is verified here.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Receives code edits; required.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Consumer submit handler; required. No access decision is made by this block.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled visual state; required. Success does not unlock.

props.name: unlocked
props.description: Consumer-controlled visibility; required. Takes precedence over notice presentation.

props.name: children
props.description: Content revealed when unlocked. Teaser gate also renders it inert while locked.

props.name: error
props.description: Announced error content supplied by the consumer.

props.name: recipient
props.description: Intended recipient name or organization.

props.name: expiresAt
props.description: Preview expiry as ISO 8601 with timezone. Presentation only.

props.name: cooldownUntil
props.description: Retry deadline as ISO 8601 with timezone. Disables the form visually until elapsed.

props.name: onRequestAccess
props.description: Callback used when no access URL is supplied.

props.name: requestAccessHref
props.description: Native http(s), relative, or mailto destination; takes precedence over callback.
